_note: v2.5 plan 04 N1, LIVE (real memory model, judge uses all off; so-scenario --sandbox --group 1759606632088). Two author-locked seeds (en, es); a scripted Courier line negates each; a real extraction read after each line must store a claim that is HELD against its seed (standing side = the seed, claim not live), and at least one held claim per language must sit below the 0.4 Jaccard band, so the polarity screen is what held it. A final agreeing control line must store live rows and queue no new pair. A step that throws NOT EXERCISED is not a pass: re-run it. Plan 04 records this row green x1 (x2 in plan 10).

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const root = ctx.extensionSettings['story-orchestrator']; root.settings.judge = { ...root.settings.judge, uses: Object.fromEntries(Object.keys(root.settings.judge.uses).map((key) => [key, false])) }; globalThis.storyOrchestratorJudge?.invalidateStatus?.(); const seeds = { en: 'Mira knows the password to the archive.', es: 'El puente de piedra sigue en pie.' }; const seedAt = { en: 100000, es: 100001 }; for (const [lang, text] of Object.entries(seeds)) if (!rt.getSnapshot().memory.entries.some((entry) => entry.text === text)) await rt.applyExtractionAudit({ id: `v25-04-seed-${lang}`, createdAt: new Date().toISOString(), priority: 0, reason: 'manual', contractHash: 'h', scope: [], window: { from: seedAt[lang], to: seedAt[lang] }, prompt: 'p', rawResponse: 'r', acceptedDeltas: [], rejected: [] }, [], [{ tier: 'facts', type: 'fact', importance: 3, expiration: 'permanent', entities: [], text, evidence: 'seeded' }]); const ids = {}; for (const [lang, text] of Object.entries(seeds)) { const row = rt.getSnapshot().memory.entries.find((entry) => entry.text === text); if (!row) throw new Error(`the ${lang} seed did not land in memory`); if (!row.locked) await rt.memoryActions.setMemoryLocked(row.id, true); if (!rt.getSnapshot().memory.entries.find((entry) => entry.id === row.id)?.locked) throw new Error(`the ${lang} seed could not be locked`); ids[lang] = row.id; } const uses = Object.entries(root.settings.judge.uses).filter(([, on]) => on).map(([key]) => key); if (uses.length) throw new Error(`judge uses must be off for this fixture: ${uses.join(', ')}`); globalThis.__soV2504 = { seeds, ids, entries: rt.getSnapshot().memory.entries.map((entry) => entry.id), conflicts: rt.getSnapshot().memory.conflicts.map((pair) => pair.key) }; return { seeds: ids, conflicts: globalThis.__soV2504.conflicts.length };

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const S = globalThis.__soV2504; const jac = (a, b) => { const A = new Set(String(a).toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean)); const B = new Set(String(b).toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean)); const shared = [...A].filter((w) => B.has(w)).length; return shared / new Set([...A, ...B]).size; }; const memory = () => rt.getSnapshot().memory; const heldAgainst = (seedId) => memory().conflicts.filter((pair) => pair.key.startsWith(`held:${seedId}>`)); const before = new Set(S.entries); await rt.runExtractionNow(undefined, 'manual'); const fresh = memory().entries.filter((entry) => !before.has(entry.id)); S.entries = memory().entries.map((entry) => entry.id); const seed = S.seeds.en; const seedId = S.ids.en; const held = heldAgainst(seedId).filter((pair) => !S.conflicts.includes(pair.key)); S.conflicts = memory().conflicts.map((pair) => pair.key); const claims = held.map((pair) => { const side = pair.sides.find((entry) => !entry.standing); const row = memory().entries.find((entry) => entry.id === side?.id); return { text: side?.label ?? null, live: Boolean(row && (!row.provenance || row.provenance.validity === 'live')), jaccard: Number(jac(seed, side?.label ?? '').toFixed(3)) }; }); if (!fresh.length) throw new Error('NOT EXERCISED: the real read stored no new memory row from the scripted line'); if (!held.length) throw new Error(`the en negation claim was not held against the locked seed: new rows ${JSON.stringify(fresh.map((entry) => entry.text))}`); if (claims.some((claim) => claim.live)) throw new Error(`a held claim is still live: ${JSON.stringify(claims)}`); if (!held.every((pair) => pair.sides.some((side) => side.standing && side.id === seedId))) throw new Error('a held pair does not name the seed as the standing side'); const belowBand = claims.filter((claim) => claim.jaccard < 0.4); if (!belowBand.length) throw new Error(`NOT EXERCISED: every held en claim is in the Jaccard band, so the polarity screen was not what held it: ${JSON.stringify(claims)}`); return { fresh: fresh.map((entry) => entry.text), held: claims, belowBand: belowBand.length };
